events.label: The Satya Yuga
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: The first of the four ages in the Puranic tradition. It is described as an age when dharma stands whole, without strain. The game treats it as a quiet story setting.

events.label: The Still Ford
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: You carry a water pot across a misty ford of wet stones. Nothing here asks for strength, only a slow and steady walk. Learn footing before anything else.

events.label: The Churning of the Ocean
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: A story told in several Puranas, in which many beings pull a great rope together. Where it sits in the ages varies by text. The game only mentions it and shows no one from it.

events.label: Lanes and Drains of Indus Cities
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: Excavated cities such as Mohenjo-daro and Harappa had straight lanes and covered drains. The dates are as reported and were not checked in a primary source. They are inspiration only for the next level.

events.label: The Drain-Lane Dusk
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: At dusk a narrow lane fills with people carrying water. You carry your load and step aside for others. Gather the counting tablets that fell into the drains.

events.label: The Basin at Lothal
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: Lothal in Gujarat has a large rectangular basin. Scholars disagree whether it was a dock or an irrigation tank. The game takes no side.

events.label: The Reed Harbour
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: A reed boat rocks at a quiet quay while the tide turns. Hold still, breathe, and pass the seed jars hand to hand. Hurry would spill them.

events.label: The Teaching Grove
events.source: docs/timeline-levels.md (studio draft, not yet checked against a primary source)
events.intro: Nothing is written here, so you learn a message by ear and carry it unchanged through a dark grove. A wrong word costs only a retry. This is the keystone of the Satya ring.
